lead_intro: In the Age of Exploration, Portugal and Spain were at the forefront of discovering new lands. Let's test your knowledge on this historical period.

quiz.question: Who crossed the Cape of Good Hope in 1497?
quiz.explanation: Vasco de Gama crossed the Cape of Good Hope in 1497, opening a new route to the Indian Ocean.

quiz.question: Which country agreed to share the New World with Spain?
quiz.explanation: Portugal and Spain agreed to share the New World by drawing a meridian 370 leagues west of the Cape Verde Islands.

quiz.question: In what year did Pedro Alvarez Cabral go on an expedition?
quiz.explanation: Two years after Vasco de Gama's voyage, Pedro Alvarez Cabral embarked on an expedition to new lands.

quiz.question: What innovation made exploration easier during this time?
quiz.explanation: The creation of the caraval, a more maneuverable ship, accelerated explorations along the African coasts.

quiz.question: Where did the expedition move away from in order to discover new lands?
quiz.explanation: The expedition moved away from the coast of Africa to take advantage of sea currents and discover new lands to the east.
